title: Closet Clutter Scene
description: An open white paneled door reveals a messy closet with clothes hanging on a rod and piled on the floor. The surrounding room has mustard-yellow walls adorned with two landscape paintings, a large brown laundry bag overflowing with colorful clothes in the foreground, and hardwood flooring.
prompt: A realistic interior photograph of an open white paneled closet door in a room with mustard yellow walls. Two landscape paintings hang on the left wall. A large brown laundry bag filled with colorful clothes sits in the foreground on hardwood floors. Inside the closet, clothes hang from a rod and more laundry is piled on the floor. Natural lighting, everyday domestic scene.
